title: oxalis corniculata var. preissiana
intro: Oxalis corniculata var. preissiana, commonly known as Preiss's wood-sorrel, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Oxalidaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, contributing to its use in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Preiss's wood-sorrel include its ability to act as an antimicrobial agent, antidiabetic, and antispasmodic, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
